name: dvalin-security
description: Independently scan and verify human- or agent-written code with offline-verifiable fix records.

interface.shortDescription: Independent security proof for agent-written code.
interface.longDescription: Run deterministic local scans, inspect findings, verify repairs with project checks, and re-derive Verified Fix Records offline. The executor is recorded but never trusted for the verdict.
defaultPrompt: Scan my latest changes and explain the coverage.
Verify that my security fixes resolved the findings.
Check this Dvalin fix record offline.
